rule: You cannot have AI as a co-author, or your contributions will be rejected.

rationale.advertising: Branded AI contribution credits put a vendor name in permanent public contribution history and can imply endorsement. This project treats that promotion as advertising.
rationale.independence: Advertising is banned in contribution credits to keep contributor recognition independent of vendor promotion and preserve clear responsibility.
rationale.responsibility: The person submitting work remains accountable for accuracy, review responses, provenance and rights.
rationale.preservation: Required license notices, factual tool documentation and legitimate human credit remain valid.

normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse Unicode whitespace, lowercase. Names match whole normalized names; emails match whole normalized addresses; domains match exact domain or explicit subdomain suffix.
limits: Reviewed aliases only, not universal AI detection or proof of human identity. Strict admission requires a separately reviewed approved identity registry; no organization override can remove canonical prohibitions. Company domains are not classified wholesale as AI identities.
